title: Label stability by aligned-scenario count K — the frozen 0.5 floor is crossed only at K=256

y.label: split-half Spearman of within-root action rankings

notes: Afterstate-ranker line, H40 phase-greedy-D1 continuation labels, successor-closed corpora; all three records are pilot tier. K=8 (RS-20260820T094500Z-5c1e9a04: 0.2457 mean over 2,470 held-out roots) and K=64 (RS-20260820T114500Z-2b7c9e31: 0.4462 over 2,750 fresh held-out roots) both failed the frozen 0.5 floor and carry assessment=superseded — their stability values remain the only recorded measurements at those K. K=256 (RS-20260820T142500Z-8f4a2d17): 0.6379 unconditioned over 2,523 roots, 0.8181 on the 411 decisive roots (spread > 20k), the preregistered gate metric, which passed. Decisive-root stability is NOT recorded at K=8 or K=64 — those points are omitted from the decisive series, not zero. Later K=256 gates on different corpora replicate the crossing and are not charted (different panels): 0.8144 (RS-20260820T184500Z-63c0a8e2), 0.8244 (RS-20260821T094500Z-1a7e3c55), 0.8058 (RS-20260821T134500Z-4b9d2f68). The K=8 record's noise arithmetic (within-action scenario sd ~20,922 vs median between-action gap 7,096) predicted this dose-response. The gate series is drawn as a two-point polyline because the generator has no reference-line primitive; the 0.5 floor is recorded in each record's gateChecks. The x axis is linear; the plan's log-scale suggestion is not expressible.
